breakdown.reason: The generated specification sets both the fuel inlet velocity to +0.1 m/s in x-direction and the air inlet velocity to +0.1 m/s in x-direction. The ground truth requires the air inlet velocity to be -0.1 m/s (in -x direction) to create the counter-flow configuration. The agent repeated the original error without correction.
